notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least one +1/+1 counter.
Wizard Class is level three.
description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.
